arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE customers.name = 'Calder Fasteners Ltd') AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31';
